sources.citation: Morgado, Marta. 2024. Personal experience narratives in three West African sign languages. LOT Dissertation Series 661. Utrecht: LOT (PhD, Leiden University). 550 pp.
sources.note: Nothing on stress/accent; a narrative-discourse study of AdaSL, LaSiBo and Língua Gestual Guineense (667 mentions of LaSiBo/Bouakako). 'Prosodic' occurs only regarding narrative segmentation methods (Gee & Kegl 1983); 'stress' only in the sense 'to stress the importance'.

sources.citation: Tano, Angoua Jean-Jacques. 2016. Etude d'une langue des signes émergente de Côte d'Ivoire: l'exemple de la Langue des Signes de Bouakako (LaSiBo). LOT Dissertation Series 437. Utrecht: LOT (PhD, Leiden University). 372 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. Ch. 3 'Caractéristiques phonétiques de la LaSiBo' (pp. 109-168) covers articulation channels (head/face, arm, feet, body), handshapes, place of articulation, symmetry/dominance constraints, sign types, minimal pairs and inter-signer variation. Grep of the full text for accent/stress/prosod/intonation/suprasegment/rythme hits only the bibliography (Brentari 1998 'A prosodic model...') and a non-technical 'L'accent est plutôt mis sur la parole' (p. 337).
